items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I had Slim Evans from the old days... and he was in Chicago so we got him and we had a guy - another saxophone player... and we formed this band -- for fun

ctx.x: Yeah and I had Slim Evans from the old days -- he was with the---
His name was Neirouter------ Otis Neirouter.
